name: bucket-helper
summary: Bucket Helper — utility functions for AWS S3 and any S3-compatible object storage (MinIO, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, etc.) via boto3, exposed as library, argparse CLI, click CLI, and FastAPI HTTP surface. credentials() loader, upload / download / list / delete / exists / make_bucket / remote_tempfile.
